title: Maximal-ideal equality after the group-order root extension
statement: Let i:U -> L and W -> U be a finite etale G-torsor, G finite. Let phi:Spec R -> L, f in R, and an isomorphism beta:U times_L Spec R = D(f) compatible with the maps to Spec R. Let H be a commutative Noetherian R-algebra via b, put g=b(f) and n=|G|, assume n is invertible in H, multiplication by g is injective, and H/(g) is a domain. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Assume prime localizations containing t are regular local and N is locally Noetherian. Pull the given torsor back to $V$, obtaining $p:P\to V$. Assume $p$ is finite etale. Set $a=p\circ V.\iota:P\to N$ and let $a^{\mathrm{norm}}:a.\mathrm{normalization}\to N$ be its concrete relative normalization; assume this map is finite. Let j:D -> N be a regular integral effective Cartier centre with image N minus V. At each normalization point $x$ above $j(\eta)$, where $\eta$ is generic in $D$, let $B=\mathcal O_{N,a^{\mathrm{norm}}(x)}$ and $C$ be the source normalization stalk at $x$, and let $v:B\to C$ be the structural stalk map. Then $\mathfrak m_B C=\mathfrak m_C$, namely the image under $v$ of the maximal ideal of $B$ generates the maximal ideal of $C$. No residue-separability assertion is included.

source.place: Tags 09EB (more-algebra-lemma-galois-conclusion), 0BRM (lemma-abhyankar), 0EYG (pione-lemma-abhyankar-one-divisor), and 0307 (lemma-integral-closure-localize); the ramification-index-one clause. Tag 09E7 (adic formal smoothness criterion) identifies the two conclusions of adic formal smoothness.

proof.text: Apply root_divisor_generic_prime with n=Nat.card G>0. Transport its conclusion along a.fromNormalization(x)=j(eta), identifying the base prime as the ideal spanned by the explicit root t.

Since t belongs to this prime, the prime-localization regularity hypothesis applies. Transport regularity to the base scheme stalk through StructureSheaf.stalkIso. The scheme stalk is the prime localization of A, so IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal identifies its maximal ideal with the span of the germ of t.

Apply root_normalization_cotangent_root at x and the identified root prime, obtaining m_C <= (v(t))+m_C^2. Finiteness of the normalization over the locally Noetherian base gives a locally Noetherian source and hence a Noetherian stalk C. Map the base principal-ideal equality through v to identify J=m_B C with (v(t)). Apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot to the finitely generated ideal m_C and its maximal ideal, obtaining m_C <= J. The opposite inclusion is IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le. This is a complete Lean proof from the two named parts, with the tame cotangent calculation left as a separate item.

theorem root_normalization_generic_stalk_maximalIdeal
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (N.presheaf.stalk (a.fromNormalization x))).map
          (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom =
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x)
